text.p: BRUSSELS, Dec 10 (Reuter) The Commission released the following documents after its weekly meeting in Strasbourg on Tuesday:
- IP/96/1142: Commission gives green light for Finnish Objective 2 programme.
- IP/96/1145: Commission adopts a proposal on the ban of beef and sheep tissues.
- IP/96/1151: Commission approves ECU 120 million aid to support economic and social reforms in Morocco.
- IP/96/1152: Commission adopts draft notice on access to telecoms networks.
- IP/96/1157: Commission approves draft negotiating mandate for creation of a European organisation responsible for civil aviation safety.
